summary: CreateFileMappingW and MapViewOfFile in mono's read-only form (specs/work_list.json: five assemblies per run, never unmapped). A PAGE_READONLY mapping of a file opened for reading succeeds and sets the last error to 0; an empty file is ERROR_FILE_INVALID, a size past the file ERROR_NOT_ENOUGH_MEMORY, no read access or PAGE_READWRITE on a read handle ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED, a closed handle ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE. A FILE_MAP_READ or FILE_MAP_COPY view starts on a 64 KB boundary, holds the file's bytes and zeros to its last page's end, outlives the file's and the mapping's handles, and VirtualQuery reports it MEM_MAPPED, committed PAGE_READONLY, its pages rounded; the rest of the 64 KB granule is free. Mapping more bytes than the file, or FILE_MAP_WRITE, is ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED.
